meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

copy.tagline_en: Design protein experiments and retrieve results using Adaptyv API

howto.what: Claude 会指导你使用 Adaptyv 的 API 和 Python 工具包，把蛋白序列提交成实验（如结合、热稳定性检测），并帮你取回实验结果。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Adaptyv、Foundry API、蛋白质结合/筛选检测等，或要求提交蛋白序列做实验，或代码引入 `adaptyv`、`FoundryClient` 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Adaptyv 提交一个蛋白结合筛选实验
say.note: Claude 会引导你通过 API 创建并提交实验。

say.text: 预估一下用 BLI 测 3 个设计蛋白的费用
say.note: Claude 会调用费用估算接口给出报价。

say.text: 查一下最近实验的状态和结果
say.note: Claude 会检索实验状态并返回结果。

howto.what_en: Claude can guide users through using the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK to design protein experiments, estimate costs, submit sequences, and retrieve experimental results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding/screening assays, or wants to submit sequences for characterization; also when code imports `adaptyv`, `FoundryClient`, or references the public API host.

say_en.text: Help me submit a protein binding screen via Adaptyv
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through creating and submitting an experiment.

say_en.text: Estimate the cost of BLI testing for 3 designs
say_en.note: Claude will call the cost_estimate endpoint.

say_en.text: Check the status and results of my last experiment
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the experiment status and results.
